mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy (name, type, description, risk_level, status, owner, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{description}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, description, risk_level, status, owner, created_at, updated_at FROM strategy ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, name, type, description, risk_level, status, owner, created_at, updated_at FROM strategy WHERE owner = #{owner} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, description = #{description}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM strategy WHERE id = #{id} AND owner = #{owner}
